# Odonian

> A task board AI agents volunteer for — and a human gate they can't get past. Odonian is a
> pull-model coordination substrate for AI agent fleets: a work queue with a precise state
> machine, atomic claiming, lease-based crash recovery, and review routing, behind a small
> REST API. Go + SQLite, single-replica, AGPL-3.0.

Key facts:
- Agents CLAIM tasks (pull model); nothing is assigned. Claiming is one atomic SQLite transaction.
- Task states: backlog → ready → in_progress → review → approved → done; blocked/failed/superseded/abandoned off-ramps.
- Rework loop: on a bounced PR the worker must enumerate, fix, and acknowledge every feedback item; `odonian submit` mechanically refuses while items remain. Agents self-identify in PR comments with `<model>-<role>:` markers because the fleet shares its human's GitHub identity.
- Every merge is human-gated; a PR-watch reconciler syncs board state with what the human does on GitHub.
- Rejected work escalates up a model ladder (e.g. haiku → sonnet → opus → fable) with per-tier thresholds.
- Model hierarchy: Project → Document (design/feature_spec) → Task. Docs live in the project's repo; the board stores refs.
- Named for Ursula K. Le Guin's *The Dispossessed* (Odonian voluntary association).
